name: Human Sacrifice
overview: Scripture clearly condemns human sacrifice as an abomination before the LORD, prohibiting the passing of one's children through fire to pagan gods such as Molech (Leviticus 18:21; Deuteronomy 12:31; 18:10). While some Old Testament narratives, like Abraham’s test in Genesis 22:1 and Jephthah’s vow in Judges 11:31, involve the offering of a human, these instances serve to highlight God's sovereignty and the serious consequences of misguided vows rather than endorse human sacrifice. God’s holiness demands that what is devoted to Him is set apart and cannot be redeemed or profaned (Leviticus 27:28), underscoring that human life belongs to Him and must not be sacrificed as pagan rites dictate.
